title: Definetely will try again!
text: This is the plan to do if you want to do an original plan with friends or anybody! The cook was amazing and very knowledgeable, and the paella... This is the way to do it: al dente and with good products. The attention to the detail, all the appetizers, drinks and views were a dream.
author: mar_agA8940CF

title: highly recommended
text: Amazing paella! The rice was perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and the ingredients tasted fresh and authentic. One of the best I’ve had—highly recommended!
author: R9303UPlauran

title: The best Paella in Spain
text: The best paella I have tasted in my trip through Spain, in an ideal place for a perfect evening. Highly recommended
author: Martha_R

title: Really nice experience
text: I’ve eaten paella before, but learning how it’s made from scratch gave me a whole new appreciation for it. The atmosphere was warm and friendly, and we even got to join in during the cooking process. Highly recommend!
author: xlucygl

title: Paella with a view
text: Antonio’s cooking demonstration was informative and entertaining, helped along with a bottomless wine glass (included). The Paella (seafood) was superb served with Sangria Al fresco with wonderful views from the rooftop dining area. Recommended
author: Mark_H

title: Great food in a great setting
text: As another reviewer state, Antonio was great, the food was delicious and the wine was amazing!  It's a great experience, and we actually learned a whole lot.  Definitely recommend this to anybody that enjoys food, learning and beautiful views.
author: ekhyatt

title: Authentic paella experience with wine
text: Really enjoyed this experience, authentically cooked paella, tapas, lovely wines, Sherry. A fabulous evening with roof top views. I would recommend
author: MLTCardiff

title: Loved this!!
text: We had the best time during this rooftop cooking class. Antonio was amazing.  The wine was lovely, the paella amazing, as was the sangria (best we had after three days in Seville and seven days in Spain). We learned about Spain’s culture and food and wine. Best three hours spent in Seville. Would do it again in a heartbeat.  Thank you Antonio!!
author: drjoeseph
